en: Black-and-white image of a quiet, tree-lined residential street bordered by elegant late 19th–early 20th century villas. On the right are large houses with stucco facades, shuttered windows, a glazed veranda, and ornate iron fencing on stone posts. On the left are similarly grand villas partly covered with ivy and topped with steep roofs and decorative spires. The unpaved road runs straight into the distance with a few utility poles, but no cars or visible people. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the front.
